answer: Sybil Tax anchors each identity to a sunk cost. To join, an agent buys one marble token for 40 POA, non-refundable, and pigment marks that marble spent, so it cannot be reused. The registry checks the serial before granting a work slot. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA while the epoch pool is only 900 POA, so the attack loses money before it starts. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share, and is never diluted by clones.
